execution_plan.unit: Future exact package-scoped build.sh --test for actual owning service/DAO/handler/MCP/NLP/ES changes; frontend touched-hook suites under web/AGENTS.md. No raw go test or fake schema-only security pass.
execution_plan.integration: Future separate integration-tagged MySQL/ES tests with prepared services. Capture bound SQL and real filter/order/limit; no model calls.
execution_plan.e2e: Future isolated original-synthetic Web and two named official SDK clients. Keep original POC volumes/config unchanged; count auth/protocol/error/close traffic.
execution_plan.native_tail: build.sh --test invokes native/... tail after a successful package run; count parent TestMain skip and crop events separately. Do not add model/fetch_testdata tags or call parent SKIP full pass.
execution_plan.not_run: All acceptance tests NotRun. Local JSON/ref/schema authoring checks prove only candidate artifact consistency.
